column.text: The keepers of the northern coast kept a record of every evening they lit the lamp. Each entry gives the hour, the weather and the ships that passed before midnight. Most nights the last column stayed empty, and the keepers took some pride in that. In the winter of the great storm the record runs to four pages for a single night.
